# Inkwire

> Inkwire is an open protocol (REST + JSON) for publishing and editing content (blog posts, pages, docs) on any website: upsert by external_id, read/list/edit/delete with ETag/If-Match, image upload, server-side Markdown sanitization, portable SEO defaults, read-only keys. A site that implements it can be operated by an agent.

You are probably here to add Inkwire to a site, or to change the protocol or a receiver. Read in this order.

## Add it to a site

- [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md): the whole procedure for a human or an agent. Run `npx create-inkwire --yes` in the site's project root (Next.js App Router or Express; FastAPI prints manual steps), then make the site render published entries (SEO page snippets for Next.js and Express, notes for Astro and FastAPI), then verify. Keys are shown once; never commit them.
- [packages/create-inkwire](packages/create-inkwire/README.md): what the generator writes and its flags.
- Read-only filesystem hosts (Vercel, Netlify) must use the GitHub store; INSTALL.md section "Deploying" has the exact env block.

## The contract

- [inkwire/SPEC.md](inkwire/SPEC.md): source of truth for endpoints, fields, error codes, SEO Profile 1.
- [inkwire/schema/](inkwire/schema/): JSON Schemas (content, patch, media, discovery); authoritative where prose and schema disagree.
- Endpoints: `POST/GET /api/content`, `GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/content/{id}`, `POST /api/media`, `GET /api/inkwire` (discovery: features, kinds, limits). Bearer auth; keys ending `:ro` are read-only. Every response carries `Inkwire-Version: 1`. Errors are `{"error":{"code","message"}}`.

## The gate (a receiver is conformant when these pass)

- API: `cd inkwire/conformance && BASE_URL=<site> API_KEY=<full key> READONLY_KEY=<ro key> node runner.mjs` runs every case for the features the site advertises. It writes test entries; use staging.
- Rendered pages: `BASE_URL=<site> API_KEY=<full key> node seo-runner.mjs` checks SEO Profile 1 output of a published entry's public page.
- Reference receivers must show `56 passed, 0 skipped, 0 failed`.

## Code map

- inkwire/receivers/core-ts: `inkwire-receiver-core` (handlers, stores, sanitizer); node-express and nextjs are thin adapters over it; python-fastapi is an independent Python core.
- inkwire/clients/node, inkwire/clients/python: publish/read/edit clients.
- Conventions: npm packages (npm install / npm test), Node 20+, no new runtime dependencies without a reason.
